title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Jamaican Umami Glaze
description: A flavorful and moist snapper dish with a rich Jamaican-inspired glaze. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Jamaican umami paste
ingredients.notes: available at most health food stores

instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the Jamaican umami paste, brown sugar, soy sauce, fish oil, and lime juice.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add the umami glaze.
Sear the snapper fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the snapper is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
